title: Orrery
description: The orchestration layer for teams of AI agents. A 10-slide keynote experience with clockwork motion.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · GSAP Observer · Motion

sections.title: Title
sections.summary: - Mono kicker "The orchestration layer for AI agents" in ultramarine.

sections.title: Problem
sections.summary: a portrait photo of a lone brass sphere at left, then the h2 "One agent *isn't* a team." and three numbered failures: "It loses the thread." / "It does everything at one depth." / "Nobody checks its work."

sections.title: The orrery (ink)
sections.summary: - h2 "Specialists on their own orbits, *kept in time.*" with a 5-row legend: The conductor, Researchers, Builders, Shared memory, The hand-off (in amber).

sections.title: How it works
sections.summary: h2 "Three steps from brief *to finished work.*" Then three columns, each with a big ultramarine serif numeral, an h3 and a line of text: Describe the work / Orrery assembles the team / Review, approve, ship.

sections.title: Use cases
sections.summary: h2 "Where teams put *it to work.*" Three cards (a 4:3 image, an h3, text): Customer operations / Research and analysis / Software engineering.

sections.title: Results
sections.summary: h2 "Measured in work *that ships.*" Three huge serif figures with ultramarine units that count up when the slide is active: 4.2×, 63%, 99.6%. Short labels and a mono footnote.

sections.title: Customers
sections.summary: a large italic serif pull quote over a faint ink-wash circle texture, plus two smaller quotes with names and roles.

sections.title: Pricing
sections.summary: h2 "Priced by the team, *not the token.*" Three tiers: Starter $49, Team $390 (ink-filled, amber "Most teams" badge) and Enterprise Custom. Each has check-mark features.

sections.title: Security (ink)
sections.summary: h2 "Built for teams that *answer to auditors.*" A 2×3 grid of claims (SOC 2 Type II, data residency, every hand-off logged, approval gates, no training on your work, SSO and SCIM) and a guilloché-texture image column.

sections.title: Book a demo
sections.summary: - Display "Put your agents *in orbit.*" and a lead paragraph.

customCodeBlocks.title: Orrery Scoped Styles
customCodeBlocks.description: Authored custom CSS variables, pseudo-elements, and keyframe rules that supplement native Webflow styles.

customCodeBlocks.title: Orrery Interactive Runtime Bridge
customCodeBlocks.description: Loads gsap, motion in page footer custom code with prefers-reduced-motion guard.
